releases.name: oc-agent-plugins 0.2.2
releases.body: Prefixes displayed plugin skill names with their owner, matching existing skill IDs (for example cloudflare:agents-sdk). Rule-backed skills use plugin:rule-name. Vendor source metadata and content are unchanged. All 519 tests and Linux/macOS/Windows CI pass; independent standards/spec reviews were clean.

releases.name: oc-agent-plugins 0.2.1
releases.body: Makes the package manager cross-platform on Linux, macOS and Windows, including CLI, native OpenCode command and approval-gated agent tool. Fixes Windows drive/UNC handling, portable Git isolation and staging ownership checks through transactions. Native three-platform CI, bundled Node lifecycle, all 518 tests and independent standards/spec reviews passed. Node >=22.14 is required; Git is needed for repository sources. Source and managed directories must not be concurrently writable by untrusted processes.

releases.name: oc-agent-plugins 0.2.0
releases.body: Adds the Node-runnable npx CLI for local and Git vendor packages, native /agent-plugins-manage commands, and the structured agent_plugins_manage tool with explicit native-question approval. Includes owned snapshot lifecycle protection, safe diagnostics and portable temporary paths. Secure package management requires Linux with /proc/self/fd and Node >=22.14. Existing npm installation continues to load the OpenCode v2 adapter. All 431 tests, CI, and independent standards/spec review gates passed.
First automated release through npm trusted publishing. Verified package, short-lived GitHub Actions OIDC authentication and provenance; no npm publishing token stored in GitHub.
